samples.question: The top card is the REFERENCE. Every card has one dot of each color and two overlapping regions: a blue circle and a purple rectangle. A dot's pattern is whether its center is inside or outside each region. Which colored border marks the bottom card where all four dot colors have exactly the same circle-and-rectangle membership pattern as the reference? Answer red, blue, or gold.
